spec.configurationPolicy: Ranges are modelling choices for review, not manufacturer offerings or load certification.
assumptions: The 16 mm top thickness is inferred from 2022 minus 2006; other main boards use the same thickness.
800 mm carcass plus 1 mm top overhang each side reconciles the 768 mm internal panels and 802 mm lid.
Shelf and fitting mount heights, rear-board thickness, oval rail section and hinge dimensions are estimates.
Six unspecified heel pads and hidden fasteners are omitted at this LOD; catalogue envelope is preserved.
Push-to-open bodies and hinges are simplified visible fittings. Technical door poses are not a mechanism simulation.
